definitions.gloss: to throw in; to stuff in; to shove in
definitions.explanation: To forcefully put something into a place. Carries a rough, aggressive nuance.

definitions.gloss: to throw someone in (prison); to lock up
definitions.explanation: To put someone into confinement, especially jail or prison. Colloquial and forceful.

notes:
A rough, colloquial compound verb: ぶち (an intensifying prefix suggesting force or violence) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to put into). The ぶち prefix adds a sense of violent or forceful action.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The thing being thrown in is marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, the destination with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

REGISTER:
Colloquial and rough. Not appropriate for formal situations. Often used by male speakers or in casual/angry speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぶち{込|こ}む: to pour money into (recklessly)
- ⟦{牢屋|ろうや}→牢屋：15832_rouya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぶち{込|こ}む: to throw in jail
- ⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぶち{込|こ}む: to slam into the goal (sports)

RELATED ぶち- COMPOUNDS:
- ぶち{壊|こわ}す: to smash, to wreck
- ⟦ぶちまける→ぶちまける：10521_buchimakeru⟧: to spill out, to pour out (feelings)
- ぶち{当|あ}たる: to slam into
